newsitem.title: USA: Eskimo sees Q2 EPS short of consensus.
newsitem.headline: Eskimo sees Q2 EPS short of consensus.

text.p: Eskimo Pie Corp said on Wednesday that its second quarter earnings will be in the range of $0.25 per share to $0.30 on a fully diluted basis, which would fall short of Wall Street analysts' expectations.
The First Call consensus estimate for the quarter ending in June is $0.35 per share. For the same period a year ago Eskimo Pie had net income of $0.47 per share, fully diluted.
Eskimo Pie also said in a news release that it has agreed to sell its Los Angeles plant and consolidate its flavors production in New Berlin, Wisc.
This move "should provide a continuing contribution of up to $0.08 per share on an annual basis in 1998 and beyond," President David Kewer said in the release.
Kewer said second quarter results were hurt by an unseasonably cold and wet spring.

He said the Eskimo Pie and Welch's brands had positive sales trends, but some sub-licensed brands are performing below expectations. He said he sees the company making progress toward returning to profitability in 1997.
The company said cash flow from selling the Los Angeles plant will more than offset the severance costs from eliminating 14 jobs there.
